provenance.sidebar_contract_toggles: Harvested from every `expectSidebarBreakpointContract(page, { toggle })` call in e2e/*.spec.ts. `capture-manifest.spec.ts` re-harvests them on every run and fails if a toggle has no candidate here.
provenance.prepass_delta: `prepass.mjs` desktop vs `--viewport mobile`, 2026-09-22: 2 of 31 routes flagged, `signup` and `subscribe` (which redirects to /signup), both on `stampedVisible` only (44 -> 37). A visible-testid diff of those two routes at 1280 vs 390 (8 browser calls, no model) found exactly one mobile-only element, `subscription-includes-compact`, and three desktop-only ones (`auth-side-panel`, `subscription-includes-panel`, `subscribe-trust-line`). The delta is a layout swap with no interaction behind it, so the bounded model session had nothing to explore: 0 model calls of the 60 allowed.
provenance.responsive_branches: Every `lg:hidden` / `sm:hidden` branch outside src/components/ui that is interactive, read from the source.
